facts.claim: The original locomotive works of the Great Indian Peninsula Railway opened at Byculla around 1854 and employed between 800 and 1000 workers.
facts.quote: The original locomotive works of the Great Indian Penin- sula Railway were opened at Byculla about 1854, and gave employment to between 800 and 1000 operatives.

facts.claim: Due to line expansion, the company moved its workshops from Byculla to Parel in 1878.
facts.quote: In course of. time the expansion of the line forced the company to look for a larger area and in 1878 a move was made from Byculla to the present workshops at Parel.
